--
-- Structure de la table `cshop_users`
--

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cshop_users` (
  `user_id` int(7) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_login` varchar(100) NOT NULL,

  `user_email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_register` date NOT NULL,

  `user_awaiting` int(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `user_banned` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB  DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 AUTO_INCREMENT=1358 ;
